kgse01.title: Take eleven of the voice note
kgse01.caption:
Who re-records a voice note eleven times before sending it?
Watch for the reveal. Take one was already lovely.

kgse02.title: The story posted for one viewer
kgse02.caption:
Ever posted a story hoping exactly one person sees it?
Guess the sign, then just tell them you thought of them.

kgse03.title: The screenshot of the first text
kgse03.caption:
Still have the screenshot of their very first hi?
Keep the memory. Let the hope rest. Guess the sign first.

kgse04.title: Same crush story, four chats
kgse04.caption:
Told the same crush story in four different chats tonight?
Guess who. Then call one friend instead.

kgse05.title: Reading it from the lock screen
kgse05.caption:
Reading their message from the lock screen so it doesn't say seen?
Guess the sign. Open it when you're ready to answer.

kgse06.title: Texted first in four seconds
kgse06.caption:
Texted first four seconds after the date ended?
Brave. Guess the sign, then put the phone down.

kgse07.title: Single at the couples' table
kgse07.caption:
The only single one at a table full of couples, and honestly thriving?
Guess the sign. Still the best seat.

kgse08.title: Three drafts and a poll
kgse08.caption:
Asked the group chat to vote on your reply? Again?
Guess the sign. Your first draft was already kind.

kgse09.title: 2 a.m. trip to forget them
kgse09.caption:
2 a.m., planning a whole trip just to stop thinking about them?
Guess the sign. The feelings come along anyway.

kgse10.title: Crying, penciled in for Thursday
kgse10.caption:
Scheduled your feelings for later in the week?
Guess the sign. Feelings don't wait for an invite.

kgse11.title: “I'm fine.” Then forty fun facts
kgse11.caption:
Someone asks if you're okay and you answer with random facts?
Guess the sign. You're allowed to not be fine.

kgse12.title: Cried at strangers getting engaged
kgse12.caption:
Cried at a video of two strangers getting engaged. Again.
Guess the sign. A big heart is not a flaw.

kgse13.title: Great advice, none taken
kgse13.caption:
The friend with perfect advice who never takes it?
Guess the sign. Say it to yourself in that same voice.

kgse14.title: No plus-one, full dance floor
kgse14.caption:
No plus-one at the wedding, still the best dancer there?
Guess the sign before the reveal.

kgse15.title: Rereading the whole chat at 2 a.m.
kgse15.caption:
2 a.m. and scrolling back to the very first message again?
Guess the sign. Old texts are a memory, not a map.

kgse16.title: Typed “what are we” and deleted it
kgse16.caption:
Typed 'what are we?' and deleted it before sending?
Guess the sign. Ask it kindly. You deserve the answer.

kgse17.title: “I don't care.” Saved the playlist
kgse17.caption:
Said you don't care, then saved their playlist anyway?
Guess the sign. Caring quietly still counts.

kgse18.title: Left on read, fifty push-ups
kgse18.caption:
Left on read, so you did fifty push-ups instead of double texting?
Guess the sign. Move the feeling, then let it go.

kgse19.title: Cancelled plans for a blanket
kgse19.caption:
Cancelled plans to stay in a blanket and felt zero guilt?
Guess the sign. Rest is a plan too.

kgse20.title: “You pick.” (They minded.)
kgse20.caption:
Said 'I don't mind, you pick' and then minded a lot?
Guess the sign. Saying what you want is allowed.

kgse21.title: The breakup told as a comedy set
kgse21.caption:
Turned your breakup into a funny story so nobody sees it hurt?
Guess the sign. Funny is fine. Sad is fine too.

kgse22.title: Answering emails to avoid feelings
kgse22.caption:
Hit inbox zero at midnight so you didn't have to feel anything?
Guess the sign. Log off. You'll be okay.
